digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center outbound comment sync
propositions: Jira Data Center outbound comment send path does not length-fit comment bodies before passing them to the transport, causing over-length comments to be rejected and re-emitted in a loop
_DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment exists but has no production caller, leaving unfitted bodies handed directly to the jira client
DC dedup key derivation via fit_comment is inconsistent with the unfitted body that actually lands, violating e339 dedup-key consistency contract
Wire _DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment into JiraDataCenterBackend.add_comment using fit_preserving_marker over comment_max_chars() ceiling to reuse Cloud's marker-preserving fitter
Re-derive _DCSanitizer.fit_comment via fit_comment_as_sent to ensure dedup key matches the marker-stripped body the fitted send actually lands
